note: Simulation results on simulated farms; not field results.

H13.rule: interval false alarms at most 1/5 of naive, and share of losses of 5+ caught at most 0.10 lower

H14.rule: recount false alarms at most half the interval rule's, and mean surveys until a loss of 5+ is caught at most 1 higher

H15.rule: on farms with unrecorded-move share above 0.05, farm-rule false alarms at most half the recount rule's
